other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Not only is the drilling operation
a 24x7 operation, the requirements of the drilling rigs has typically been roller coaster type of demand
other_continuous_flow_signals.sector: upstream oil & gas drilling (extraction, not continuous processing)

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Continuity of power framed as essential for rig safety during mud pumping
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: Thus continuity of power is an essential safety element for drilling rigs.

one_line: The paper reports an energy-management program by a drilling contractor (NDC) to optimize diesel-engine deployment on 55 upstream oil & gas drilling rigs, saving fuel, cost and CO2 — an extraction/drilling context, not continuous-flow industrial processing.
